title.narrative: Centro de Investigación para la Acción Femenina (CIPAF)

description.narrative: The Center for Research for Feminist Action (CIPAF) is a non-governmental, non-profit feminist organization, a pioneer in the defense of the rights of women and girls in the Dominican Republic, Central America and the Caribbean. Since its founding, CIPAF's historical mission has been to support the development of the women's movement, promote actions to favor their incorporation as a social subject, foster their management capacity and promote the role of women in their tasks to achieve full equality and social justice. CIPAF works in six main areas: Gender and Public Policies; Information and Communication Technologies (ICT); Education and Training; Political Participation and Local Government; Information and Communication; Data for Equality.The grant will support the following specific priorities:- Contribute to the strengthening of the feminist movement so that they can influence political and social changes;- Promote the participation of women in all spaces of power and decision-making (with a focus on political participation in the 2024 electoral process);- Improve access to technology and data to promote and guarantee the rights of citizens, particularly women and vulnerable groups due to their sexual orientation, gender identity, color, disability, etc.;- Strengthen the institutional capacities of CIPAF to promote the advancement of the women's rights agenda and the strengthening of the feminist movement;- Develop effective strategies and interventions to generate knowledge about gender violence (GBV);- Promotion of sexual and reproductive rights
